admission.justification: The renewal budget planner writes generated measurements while the record and independent current-budget checks read authored ceilings; conflating these would silently let a routine text renewal authorize a ceiling increase.

applicability: The instruction-renewal command and current capsule-budget record.
conditions: Current generated measurements are stored separately from authored ceiling decisions.
exclusions: Developer-approved authored ceiling changes, including D822, are separate from generated renewal.
A whole-current-record fingerprint or individual item budget is not required.
statement: Instruction renewal regenerates current measurements and source identities without changing authored ceilings; changing a ceiling remains the developer's decision.
